content.rendered:
?Psalms 118:15 MSG

Hear the shouts, hear the triumph songs in the camp of the saved? “The hand of God has turned the tide!?What a glorious word this morning..The tide has been turned in your favour.?Where defeat was inevitable, God turned the tide.?Where shame and reproach were inevitable, God turned the tide.?Where bad or evil feedback was expected, God just turned the tide.?Today, its beauty for ashes.✔Dancing in place of mourning✔Joy in place of sadness.✔From your camp will be shouts of rejoicing and celebration today in Jesus name????
